🏨 YOUR ACCOMMODATION

Pensión Gárate

San Sebastián • Parte Vieja
★ 8.8/10

AddressSan Martin, 54 1ª planta, 20007 Donostia-San Sebastián

Fabulous location in the heart of the old town

From Bus StationWalk ~10 minutes uphill on Paseo de Vizcaya, turn right on Avenida de Estella, continue to Plaza Guipuzcoa, then San Martin street. Or take a taxi (€5–7).

📍 Open in Google Maps

Sercotel Arenal Bilbao

Bilbao • Casco Viejo
★ 8.6/10

AddressLos Fueros, 2, 48005 Bilbao

3-star hotel with central Casco Viejo access

From TermibusWalk ~15 minutes downhill on Avenida Murguia, cross Puente del Arenal bridge, arrive at hotel near Plaza Arenal. Or take a taxi (€8–10).
